excerpts.anchor: When discussing levels of Mg in the studies
marks: an individual may be profoundly deficient in total body or intracellular Mg required for various cellular biochemical processes yet have a SMC within normal range

excerpts.anchor: The most commonly detected electrolyte abnormality in ambulatory diabetic patients
marks: A recent study of diabetics (n = 210) showed that 88.6% had Mg intake less than the RDA and 37.1% had measurable hypomagnesia

excerpts.anchor: Level I evidence supports the use of magnesium
marks: Level I evidence supports the use of magnesium in the prevention and treatment of many common health conditions
